newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton markets quiet, unmotivated.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton markets quiet, unmotivated.

text.p: An apathetic New York futures market and the absence of fundamental news allowed the pre-Christmas go-slow to continue on Europe's raw cotton markets.
The only significant influence on price movements was the relative scarcity of upland cottons, particularly from Central Asia, which has kept demand for these types alive, industry sources said.
Prices for all types were quoted unchanged with the exception of American styles which were down by up to 0.25 cents a lb. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
